hints.title: Parity Requirement
hints.text: A valid parentheses sequence must contain an even total number of characters.

hints.title: Forward Open Check
hints.text: Traversing left-to-right, open parentheses plus unlocked wildcards must never drop below locked close parentheses.

hints.title: Backward Close Check
hints.text: Traversing right-to-left, close parentheses plus unlocked wildcards must never drop below locked open parentheses.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: String must have even length; forward pass checks open capacity, backward pass checks close capacity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over wildcard placements results in exponential 2^N time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two linear sweeps verify prefix and suffix bounds in constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should verify parity first and apply bidirectional greedy checking.
